title: Top Up Via Website and Continue As Guest

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: Visit pldthome.com/fiberprepaid.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: Click ”LOAD HERE”

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: Enter your account number. You may get your account number from your activation or application SMS or email sent by PLDT Home, then click ”Continue as Guest”.

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: Select your preferred load by clicking ”Buy Now”.

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: Click CONTINUE to accept the Terms and Conditions.

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: Review your order then click ”CHECKOUT”.

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: Confirm your subscription by entering the 6-digit OTP sent via SMS or email.

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: Review the details of your order carefully then click the ”Pay with” box.

steps.label: Step 9
steps.text: Select your preferred payment method.

steps.label: Step 10
steps.text: If you select Maya, scan the QR or log in to pay.

steps.label: Step 10.1
steps.text: Click Continue. Click "Pay now". Wait for "Payment Successful" confirmation.

steps.label: Step 11
steps.text: View payment confirmation.

steps.label: Step 12
steps.text: Check successful purchase notification via SMS and email.

steps.label: Step 13
steps.text: Check your recent purchase in the account overview page.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: Go to pldthome.com and click ”Account Login”.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: Click ”Create Account”.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: Fill out the registration form and click ”Register”.

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: A confirmation email will be sent to you.

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: View the myHome registration validation email.

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: Click the ”Click here to validate account” link within 24 hours upon receiving the validation email.

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: You will be forwarded to the myHome account registration success page. Click on ”Continue” afterwards.

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: By clicking ”Continue,”, you will be logged in to PLDT myHome and can begin linking their Fiber Prepaid account number.

title: Link your New Account Number to your existing MyHome Account

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: Create your PLDT myHome account or log-in.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: Link your new account number. You may review your account number from your activation or application email or SMS sent by PLDT Home.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: Enter the One-Time Passcode (OTP) sent via SMS or email to validate your account.

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: Click ”Packages and Subscriptions”.

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: Under ”My Packages”, look for Fiber Prepaid then click ”GO”

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: Click ”BUY TOP UPS”

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: Select your preferred load by clicking ”Buy Now”.

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: Click "Continue" to accept the Terms and Conditions.

steps.label: Step 9
steps.text: Review you order then click "Check-Out" and pay.

steps.label: Step 10
steps.text: Confirm your subscription by entering the 6-digit OTP sent via SMS or email.

steps.label: Step 11
steps.text: Review the details of your order carefully then click ”Pay with” box.

steps.label: Step 12
steps.text: Select your preferred payment method.

steps.label: Step 13
steps.text: If you select Maya, scan the QR or log in to pay.

steps.label: Step 13.1
steps.text: Click Continue Click Pay Now Wait for Payment Successful confirmation

steps.label: Step 14
steps.text: View for payment confirmation.

steps.label: Step 15
steps.text: Check successful purchase notification via SMS and email.

steps.label: Step 16
steps.text: Check your recent purchase in account overview page.

title: Create New MyHome Account Via Pre-registration

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: Check your pre-registration email or SMS and click the top up link ot visit pldthome.info/prepaidload

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: Enter your account number that you can find in the activation and/or application email or SMS then click ”Continue as Guest”

steps.label: Step 3
steps.text: Select your preferred load then click ”Buy Now”

steps.label: Step 4
steps.text: Accept the Terms and Conditions

steps.label: Step 5
steps.text: Proceed to Checkout

steps.label: Step 6
steps.text: Confirm your subscription by entering the One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your email or mobile number then click ”Submit”

steps.label: Step 7
steps.text: Review your order.

steps.label: Step 8
steps.text: Pay using QR code or debit/credit card.

steps.label: Step 9
steps.text: Complete your order and wait for the payment confirmation.

steps.label: Step 10
steps.text: Payment confirmation will be sent to your email.

steps.label: Step 11
steps.text: Check your pre-registration email and click ”Nominate Password”.

steps.label: Step 12
steps.text: Create your own password, accept the Terms and Conditions, then click "Activate your account".

steps.label: Step 13
steps.text: Your MyHome account is now ready and activated.
